csv_scope_of_work: The Oklahoma Department of Aerospace & Aeronautics may be seeking a consultant to provide a Design for Hefner-Easley Airport Rehabilitate Runway 18/36. The Overall Development Objective (ODO) of the proposed project is to rehabilitate Runway 18/36. The existing runway pavement is exhibiting seasonal environmental distresses such as weathering, raveling, and longitudinal/transverse cracking. The pavement is at a point where it is more cost effective to rehabilitate than let it deteriorate until a reconstruction is required.
